actor.description: [Silent Librarian](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0122) is a group that has targeted research and proprietary data at universities, government agencies, and private sector companies worldwide since at least 2013. Members of  [Silent Librarian](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0122) are known to have been affiliated with the Iran-based Mabna Institute which has conducted cyber intrusions at the behest of the government of Iran, specifically the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC).(Citation: DOJ Iran Indictments March 2018)(Citation: Phish Labs Silent Librarian)(Citation: Malwarebytes Silent Librarian October 2020)
actor.analyst_notes: 2026-09 migration: removed or re-scoped legacy geography-derived state sponsorship, generated espionage motivation, and alias evidence that was not source-specific.

organizations.name: Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC)
organizations.relationship: U.S.-government-alleged beneficiary/client of the Mabna campaign
organizations.analyst_notes: DOJ alleges that Mabna conducted the university spearphishing campaign on behalf of the IRGC and other Iranian clients; Treasury states that the IRGC outsourced intrusions to Mabna. This is not a proven command relationship or an exact-identity assertion between Mabna and Silent Librarian.

attribution.assessment: U.S. DOJ charging documents and Treasury's 2018 designation allege that the Iran-based Mabna Institute conducted many intrusions for the IRGC and other Iranian government or university clients. Applied to Silent Librarian only through the separately modeled medium-confidence Mabna association.
attribution.analyst_notes: Source-scoped U.S.-government allegation, not an adjudicated finding. Iran/IRGC is not inferred from target geography, language, infrastructure, or residence, and state-aligned does not imply organizational subordination.

diamond_model.analyst_notes: Legacy source-unbound prose was cleared in the 2026-09 evidence audit; use evidence-linked activity-level Diamond models.

activities.name: Mabna Instituteによる大学・組織侵入キャンペーン（2013–2017）
activities.description: 米司法省の2018年および2026年の起訴発表によると、Mabna Instituteの関係者は約2013年から少なくとも2017年12月まで、大学その他の組織を対象とするスピアフィッシングと資格情報窃取キャンペーンを実施したとされる。2026年資料の集計は、米国144大学、国外178大学、米国企業42社以上、国外企業11社以上、米国の連邦・州政府機関5機関以上、NGO 2団体以上である。教授アカウント10万件超を標的とし約8,000件を侵害、31.5TB以上の学術・知的財産データを窃取したとされる。米国大学が対象データの調達・アクセスへ支出した34億ドル超は、窃取額や被害損失の評価ではない。
activities.analyst_notes: Campaign名は法執行見出しではなく観測された活動を中立に表す。期間はDOJが明示した約2013年〜少なくとも2017年12月だけを採用し、2018/2026年の公開・起訴日を活動期間へ転用していない。reported_atは最初のDOJ公表日。DOJ資料はMabna Instituteの被疑活動を述べるため、Silent Librarianとの接続はMITRE ATT&CKが述べる構成員のaffiliationを介したmedium-confidence境界とし、exact identityや直接の高確度ターゲット主張へ強めない。
